credits.title: Madden
credits.overview: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football’s most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.

credits.title: Clean Hands
credits.overview: Based on a true story, a veteran narcotics officer turned recovery advocate and his daughter, who struggles with addiction, confront the American drug crisis from opposing sides of the law while navigating their complicated family bond.

credits.title: Rolling Loud: The Movie
credits.overview: Desperate to reconnect with his distant son, a father secretly takes him to the chaos of Rolling Loud, only to plunge into a wild, frantic search across the massive hip-hop festival when the 13-year-old vanishes into the crowd.

credits.title: Three Housewives and a Body
credits.overview: Lorelai loves living in her neighborhood, right next to best friends Jackie and Ella. During girl's night at Jackie's house a home invasion goes terribly wrong when the three women accidentally kill a man.

credits.title: Thou Shall Not Commit Adultery
credits.overview: When Cassie, a Christian feminist icon and bestselling author, is blackmailed with videos of her affair, she must fight to protect her brand and marriage. But as her trusted assistant's betrayal escalates, Cassie faces a terrifying choice.

credits.title: I Love Boosters
credits.overview: A group of shoplifters take aim at a cutthroat fashion maven by stealing from her stores and reselling them at a lower price — what they call 'fashion-forward philanthropy'.

credits.title: Pushed Off a Plane and Survived
credits.overview: Jaynie miraculously cheats death after her husband Cole’s betrayal.

credits.title: The Past Is Never Buried
credits.overview: Emily, desperate to find answers about her mother's murder 22 years prior, returns to her hometown when her father, also a suspect in her mother's death, is arrested for the homicide of a local teenager.

credits.title: Politickin'
credits.overview: In a sparked classroom seminar, students discuss the true "weapons" of resiliency.

credits.title: Christmas Everyday
credits.overview: When a water pipe bursts and disrupts her sister's wedding plans, Fancy finds herself drawn to the rugged yet charming contractor. Through all the chaos, she learns valuable lessons about faith, family, and the true meaning of Christmas.

credits.title: Eric Jerome Dickey's Friends and Lovers Part I
credits.overview: Four friends' lives become intertwined when romance blooms between a doctor and a comedian, while his best friend falls for her free-spirited bestie. After a tragic event, their relationships evolve into something deeper than friendship.

credits.title: Trouble Man
credits.overview: Jaxen, a former cop turned Atlanta PI, is hired to find missing R&B star Jahari. His investigation uncovers her disappearance is connected to a larger conspiracy, forcing him to question those around him and his own past.

credits.title: STRAW
credits.overview: What will be her last straw? A devastatingly bad day pushes a hardworking single mother to the breaking point — and into a shocking act of desperation.

credits.title: The Piano Lesson
credits.overview: A brother and sister's battle over a prized heirloom piano unleashes haunting truths about how the past is perceived — and who defines a family legacy.
